title: k11 Performance QA MCP Server
description:
MCP server and CI tool for load and performance testing as release evidence: API functional test flows reused as load scenarios, per-endpoint latency percentiles, error rates and throughput, SLO checks, and regressions against a baseline that require a tolerance, a minimum delta and statistical significance (Mann-Whitney U), with k6 or a builtin engine and guardrails that keep load away from production.

Source code: https://github.com/K11-Software-Solutions/k11techlab-performance-qa-mcp
